title: BRAZILIAN PORTUGUESE IMAGE CAPTIONING WITH TRANSFORMERS: A STUDY ON CROSS-NATIVE-TRANSLATED DATASET

bias_targets.methodology: Quantitative cross-source evaluation comparing model performance (using metrics like CIDEr, BLEU, BERTScore, and CLIP-Score) on native human-generated Brazilian Portuguese captions versus machine-translated captions from English, to assess the impact of translation artifacts, domain shift, and the loss of cultural and linguistic nuances.

Qualitative analysis using cross-attention maps to visualize word-level image attention, identifying the model's unfounded preference for generating gender-specific terms (e.g., 'men') when visual evidence is ambiguous or uncertain, thereby perpetuating societal gender biases.
